updates.title: Guided photo capture flow for vehicle images
updates.description: Added a guided vehicle photography feature with step-by-step instructions and frame overlays for sedans and SUVs, guided interior photo capture, custom photo uploads with reordering, photo retake and preview options before saving, and a before-and-after photo comparison slider, with editing disabled for sold vehicles.

updates.title: Deal Worksheet: Fees, Warranty, Guarantee, Insurance and Accessories
updates.description: Added live data and detailed views for deal worksheet items, with dropdown options loaded dynamically from the server when adding new entries.

updates.title: Licence Scanning, Note Attachments and Login Improvements
updates.description: Added licence scanning to automatically fill customer and lead details, licence uploads in Customer Details, note image previews, smarter credit application fields, and improved login, sign-out, and app version visibility.

updates.title: Vendors Module
updates.description: Introduced a new Vendors module to list, search, view, add, and edit vendors, along with driver's licence barcode/QR scanning to automatically fill customer and lead details

updates.title: Feature: Print Option
updates.description: Added a Print option in the Inventory and Leads modules, allowing users to print vehicle details from the Inventory module and lead details from the Leads module.

updates.title: Negative Fee Values and Easier Fee Entry
updates.description: Updated Deal Fees to support negative amounts for discounts and adjustments, improved numeric input validation, enhanced tax calculation checks, and simplified fee entry for a smoother user experience.

updates.title: Export Vehicle inspection Report to PDF
updates.description: Added PDF export for vehicle inspection reports, enabled editing of inspection items, and improved inspection screen layouts for a cleaner and more user-friendly experience.

updates.title: Lien details, purchase proof uploads and inventory fixes
updates.description: Added lien details entry and proof capture for inventory vehicles, attachment editing, purchase proof document uploads, standardized photo and file picker labels, and fixed Inventory screen crashes, sheet scrolling issues, and duplicate navigation during sign-out.

updates.title: VIN decoding fix and redesigned inspection cards
updates.description: Improved VIN decoding in the Inventory Module and updated the Digital Vehicle Inspection screens with better comment visibility, redesigned inspection cards, and improved form validation.

updates.title: Faster Image Uploads and More Reliable Licence Scanning
updates.description: Improved image upload speed through compression, prevented scanned and manually entered licence details from overwriting each other, and made customer creation errors clearer.

updates.title: Redesigned Dashboard and Auto-Save in Inspections
updates.description: Redesigned the Dashboard, In Digital Vehicle Inspection added automatic saving of inspection comments and failure reasons with save status indicators, ensured changes are saved before completing inspections, and fixed flickering on the Edit Inventory screen.

updates.title: New side menu design and optional test drive photos
updates.description: Redesigned the side menu with a profile section and updated icons, made test drive photos optional, displayed the Photos section only when photos are available, and improved the Test Drive Details screen layout.

updates.title: Smoother refresh, better keyboard handling and cleaner listings (Android)
updates.description: Added automatic refresh for Inventory and DVI listings, improved keyboard handling during inspections, displayed more vehicle details on Inventory cards, improved Dashboard scrolling on smaller screens, and removed extra blank space from listing screens.

updates.title: Test Drive Module
updates.description: Introduced a complete Test Drive module with customer and vehicle selection, photo capture, live GPS route tracking, odometer readings, customer signatures, PDF/CSV exports, and test drive history with search and filters.

updates.title: Syndication settings fix
updates.description: Fixed crashes in vehicle syndication settings and ensured saved syndication selections load correctly when editing a vehicle.

updates.title: Vehicle Details Loading and Action Button Improvements
updates.description: Added loading skeletons to the Vehicle Details screen, improved quick-action button visibility and behavior when switching tabs, and fixed layout issues when loading multiple attachments

updates.title: Feature: Deal Jacket
updates.description:
Added a Deal Jacket tab in Deal Details to upload, scan, categorize, view, and manage deal documents. 
- Includes document tagging, required document indicators, automatic Uncategorized storage, image/PDF handling, native gallery picker, and improved document saving and PDF viewing.

updates.title: Digital Vehicle Inspection (DVI)
updates.description: Introduced a new Digital Vehicle Inspection (DVI) module to help users inspect vehicles, record issues, and track inspection progress easily.

updates.title: Attachments, Purchase and Expenses Tabs in Vehicle Details
updates.description: Introduced new Attachments, Purchase, and Expenses tabs in the Inventory module to manage vehicle documents, purchase details, vendor information, and expenses in one place.

updates.title: Deals Module
updates.description: Introduced the Deal Module with deal listing, importing, tax calculations, printable documents, credit applications, financing options, and inventory enhancements including VIN decoding, vehicle tags, and photo reordering.
